Name: The Price of Timber - A Robin Romance Mod
Author: spphcmttron
Description:
[center]Ever thought Pelican Town's hardworking carpenter deserved better? Do you wish you could talk sense into Demetrius, or simply urge the couple to split up? Ever fantasized about swooping down and claiming Robin as your own?[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Well, now you can![/center]
[center] [/center]
Before you install, see "[b]IMPORTANT[/b]" below.

[b][color=#ffffff][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]At least 300 lines of daily dialogue which expand on Robin's character, hints about her backstory and relationships with other NPCs.[/*]
[*]7 new portraits, so she can blush. Or cry over her crumbling marriage.[/*]
[*]10+ new events (with more to come!) with a few different "endings" to Robin's path. (See "Event Guide" below.)[/*]
[*]Custom tiles for spouse room and patio.[/*]
[*]Custom wedding attire.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Strongly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31770]Self-Checkout[/url] with this mod in order to access the carpentry shop regardless of Robin's spouse schedule.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
Unzip contents into your mods folder. Installing mid-save might create a backlog of events.

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Custom tiles toggle: Turns off custom tiles for recolor compatibility. Off by default.[/*]
[*]Mature dialog: Enables spicy flavored dialog variants, nothing explicit. [b]Off by default.[/b][/*]
[*]More to come[/*]
[/list][center][b][size=5]IMPORTANT[/size][/b][/center]

As of 11/2026, this is an early release version of this mod. As such:
[list]
[*]Compatibility with NPC mods, custom village mods, other expansion mods is not yet implemented. Essentially, only vanilla compatibility is guaranteed. [i]SVE compatibility is the topmost priority. [/i][/*]
[*]Robin's 14 heart romance is not completed. It'll be quite an undertaking, [i]since you'll get to meet her parents![/i][/*]
[*]Content related to the Cinema and the Resort is not fleshed out.[/*]
[/list]If you wish to wait for this content, go ahead! However, if you want to see what I've cooked up for Robin's storyline up to her 12 heart event, then please give it a shot. I'll be very happy to know my writing finally has someone else's eyes on it! (And share your thoughts too!)

[center]In addition: [b]Robin will not have children with the farmer[/b], nor will she flower dance. More details about this below.[/center]
[line]
[b][size=4]Compatibility issues[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Anything that changes Robin's portrait/sprites/dialogue. [/*]
[*]Demetrius might experience conflict with dialogue expansion mods, since his daily lines have to be edited depending on event choices.[/*]
[*]Other NPCs have topic memory dialogue only, mainly Sebastian and Maru. There might still be issues.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Upcoming [/size][/b]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]14 heart event (PRIORITY)[/*]
[*]Group jealousy scene (you can guess with whom.)[/*]
[*]Custom wedding event[/*]
[*]GIft reactions[/*]
[*]More dialogue[/*]
[*]More config options (including small toggles for text flavor and/or compatibility options)[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Seasonal Cute Outfits[/*]
[/list][b]Other Details[/b]
[list]
[*][b]This mod does not feature adultery [/b][s](yet?)[/s] You must persuade Robin to leave her current marriage before you give her a bouquet, which will unlock her romance path. [/*]
[*][b]Robin will not have children with the player.[/b] The more I wrote her the less sense it made for her to want more, both as a very active career woman and as a mother to adult children. In addition, her relationship with her existing family will be complicated after the divorce (and subsequent remarriage), so I imagined she wouldn't want to bring a baby into the mix. I may or may not change my mind on this in the future. [/*]
[*][b]Robin will not flower dance.[/b] Though she will be very endeared that you asked. It felt very in character that she'd be averse to being in the spotlight like that, and too embarrassed to be seen by the other moms in town.[/*]
[*]Robin is rather dominant in her affections regardless of farmer gender. Future versions will include a flavor toggle that reduces the intensity of this (mostly so I can double down on future dialogue additions lol.)[/*]
[*]While this is labeled as a Romance mod, you can choose to remain friends with Robin. You'll still get events and tons of daily dialogue. [/*]
[*]Gift tastes remain unchanged.[/*]
[/list][line]

Choose "Support Demetrius" to get them to reconcile. You will not be able to romance Robin.[/spoiler]
[b]Romance events[/b]
[spoiler][b]Bouquet event[/b]
If you chose to separate them, give Robin a bouquet. She won't take it, but will show up at your doorstep the next morning.
To proceed with her romance choose:
"I like you" and "I want you as you are"
Robin will ask for time. After two weeks, she will send you a letter. She will finally accept your bouquet.

[spoiler][b]Reconcile event [/b]
If you encourage Robin and Demetrius to reconcile in 8 heart part 3 event, you will get mail from Demetrius in two weeks. He will invite you over to their house. He will ask you for another canteloupe.
Location: Robin's house
Time: 6AM to 9AM

Lastly, there is a secret event that you can trigger [b]if you manage to anger Robin enough.[/b][/spoiler]
